description: MariaDB root credential is stored plaintext in a world-readable config file and is reused as the system root password.
detailed_description: /etc/mysql/conf.d/db_root.cnf is readable by any user and contains the MariaDB root password in plaintext. The same string is also the system root password, a common misconfiguration when service and admin credentials are rotated together. An attacker reads the config, extracts the password, and authenticates as the local root user.
